description: Show the organization's plan, its limits and current usage, to check that new monitors, heartbeats or regions fit before creating them or to explain a 403 naming a limit. Region codes and their cities come from list_regions; billing changes happen only in the dashboard. Values are current as of the call. Returns plan (one of FREE, PLUS, PRO, MAX, ENTERPRISE), limits and usage. limits: max_monitors, min_interval_seconds, max_fast_monitors (monitors below fast_interval_threshold_seconds, 60), max_regions per monitor, allowed_regions, max_heartbeats, max_maintenance_windows, history_retention_days, api_rate_limit_per_minute (shared by the whole organization), renotify_interval_seconds and renotify_max_count (how often and how many times an open, unacknowledged incident is alerted again; 0 means no reminders); null means no limit. usage: monitors (paused included), fast_monitors and heartbeats.
name: get_plan_usage
